decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the established consumer health business, fits the strategy of broadening the portfolio, and shows no sign of falling short of aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A pharmacy skin and hair supplement close to the core is cheap to carry, and an expanding firm has the slack to keep it despite the missing recent evidence.

The niche immune supplement got little visibility and its results are uncertain, but immune products saw stronger demand during the pandemic and it costs little near the core, so slack favours keeping it.

The valsartan generic is distant from the core and was damaged by the recall, but as a regulated prescription generic for a chronic condition it supports the broad generics range, so management keeps it while its contribution stays under review.
The OTC triptan was launched recently with its own page, gives the firm a distinctive self-medication position, and still has time to meet aspirations given the firm's investment slack.
